applicable_to: commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
required_topics: Identification of human trafficking in the hospitality industry
Role of commercial lodging establishments in addressing sex trafficking
Different types of hotel contract workers vulnerable to labor trafficking
Reporting and responding to human trafficking incidents
recordkeeping_requirements: maintain records showing compliance with the law
risks_or_constraints: Employees may not be disciplined, retaliated against, or discriminated against for making a good faith report of suspected human trafficking.
